entities.summary: Eric O'Dell is a Canadian professional ice hockey player. He is currently an unrestricted free agent who most recently played with Ak Bars Kazan of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). O'Dell was originally selected by the Anaheim Ducks in the second round of the 2008 NHL Entry Draft and has played in the National Hockey League with the Winnipeg Jets.
